label: Wallet → actions
description: Create a note secret, prove spendability, then bind a spend or output into an action. Rounded nodes shared by several arrows represent a header type, not one shared proof instance.

label: Epoch → buckets
description: Accumulate stamp sets, route them by quadratic-residuosity profiles, and seal buckets between epoch entry anchors. Splitting alone does not prove classification: selection and descent do that.

label: Nullifier exclusion
description: Prove absence in closed-epoch buckets, compose that evidence across epochs, and bind it to a note. A service can build ArbitraryUnspent; the wallet binds it to its NoteNullifiers.

label: Evidence trees
description: Build and open a serving index over sealed buckets. The tree carries roots; EvidenceTreeOpen supplies a bucket polynomial and checks its commitment against the leaf.

label: Actions → stamps
description: Combine actions, attach fees, merge or subtract stamps, and lift anchors. AnchorSpan is the separate proof of an anchor interval used by the lift steps.

label: Complete map
description: All 39 registered steps and 17 header types. This is a type dependency map: loops mean repeated proof composition, not a circular proof. Use the focused views or select a step to inspect its exact inputs.
